description: List the tickets (attendees) for an event, optionally one date of it and complete or cancelled only: attendee name, ticket type, price, check-in state and seating. Paged. Humanitix: GET /v1/events/{eventId}/tickets.

event_date_id.description: The event date id (24-character hex id).

override_location.description: Query a region other than your account's own (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). Humanitix stores data per region.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

since.description: Only results created/updated since this ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z.

name: humanitix_list_tickets
title: List an event's tickets
